command: set -e; SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"; ADB="$SDK/platform-tools/adb"; test -x "$ADB"; DEVICES="$("$ADB" devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | sed '/^$/d')"; test "$DEVICES" = "RFCT70L7E8J"; MODEL="$("$ADB" -s RFCT70L7E8J shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')"; test "$MODEL" = "SM-S906B" -o "$MODEL" = "SM_S906B"; echo PHONE_DEVICE=$DEVICES MODEL=$MODEL
